purpose: verified-4.1: reviewed bioactivity records of three species whose MBPI stays withheld, kept as partial evidence so the page shows what was found and which step is missing (team-lead request 2026-10-04 to check every '미확인' item). None of them enters a score. 4.1: the 꽃게 record left this file — the origin species was settled on public sequence records and it now carries a score in the AMP stratum. 4.3 (2026-10-05): the 참조기 XO record left this file — its peptides are scored in the new XO stratum (evidence-xo-4.3-2026-10-05.json). Three 갑오징어 records were added: each fails two or more conditions, so the one-condition relaxation (prereg-fill-all-4.3 1.4) does not apply and the species keeps the floor MBPI; they show what was found. The 참문어 Zhou 2025 record was re-read in full text (still no single MIC), and a cephalotocin record was added; neither scores.

yu_2020_md_sepia.provider: Marine Drugs 18(10):490 (MDPI), full text in PMC7599988
yu_2020_md_sepia.title: Antioxidant peptides from Sepia esculenta hydrolyzate attenuate oxidative stress and fat accumulation in Caenorhabditis elegans (Yu X et al. 2020)
yu_2020_md_sepia.terms: Peptide sequences and assay type recorded

zhou_2025_fsi_octopus.provider: Fish & Shellfish Immunology 163:110408 (Elsevier), abstract on PubMed (PMID 40360041)
zhou_2025_fsi_octopus.title: Screening and preliminary analysis of antimicrobial peptide genes in Octopus sinensis (Zhou Y et al. 2025)
zhou_2025_fsi_octopus.terms: Full text read from the team lead's library PDF on 2026-10-05 (not stored in the repository). Synthetic peptides (GenScript), LB broth, 96-well plates, growth curves at OD600; no per-bacterium MIC value in the text, tables or figures.

ding_2011_cjnm_qpk.title: Anticancer activity of an oligopeptide isolated from hydrolysates of Sepia ink (Ding G-F et al. 2011)
ding_2011_cjnm_qpk.license: Publisher terms; values and wording recorded only
ding_2011_cjnm_qpk.terms: Full text read from the team lead's library PDF (sha256 4b7a52b58bac97796fbda5745e17d0ee515d5aa42ba5b9c620138d3059706ba8, not stored in the repository). Species stated as sepia esculenta, identified by Prof. Zhao Shen-Long.

jing_2014_mfst_shp.provider: 现代食品科技 (Modern Food Science and Technology) 30(9):1-6
jing_2014_mfst_shp.title: 乌贼墨多肽诱导人前列腺癌DU-145细胞凋亡的机制研究 (景奕文·杨最素·黄芳芳·郁迪·丁国芳 2014)
jing_2014_mfst_shp.terms: Open PDF. IC50 values in the text; the Chinese methods text is not machine-readable (font without a Unicode map), so species name and purification step were not confirmed in this paper.

huang_2017_mmr_shp.title: Sepia ink polypeptide SHP (LKEENRRRRD) and PC-3 prostate cancer cells (Huang F, Jing Y, Ding G, Yang Z 2017)
huang_2017_mmr_shp.terms: Full text and publisher XML read: species sepia esculenta (Nanzhen Market, Zhoushan; identified by Prof. Sheng-Long Zhao); sequence LKEENRRRRD, 1371.53 Da; 'IC50' appears nowhere in the text, tables or figure captions; no supplementary files.

kim_2022_md_cephalotocin.title: An Octopus-Derived Peptide with Antidiuretic Activity in Rats (Kim et al. 2022)
kim_2022_md_cephalotocin.terms: Open full text: synthetic cephalotocin (CYFRNCPIG-NH2, >98%) EC50 at human V2 and V1b receptors in the text. The paper names the source species Octopus vulgaris without a sampling region; the sequence papers (Reich 1992, Univ. Ulm; Takuwa-Kuroda 2003) give no public collection locality.
